page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ae.4xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 8 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor, operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes 32 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. This instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage options, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core CPU tests placing the instance in the top 10% of its class. Geekbench single-core and text processing benchmarks also demonstrate strong performance, ranking in the top 25%. Multi-core performance, including stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core tests, falls within the average range. Memory bandwidth tests, such as read-only small block cached operations at 1233.02 GB/sec and large block uncached read/write operations, consistently align with average tier expectations. Cryptographic capabilities are supported by hardware-accelerated instruction sets including AES, VAES, and SHA_NI.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high single-core performance offer a balanced profile for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local NVMe storage. The lack of bundled local storage means storage performance depends entirely on network-attached volumes. This instance is well-suited for workloads such as web serving, software compilation, text processing, and moderate database operations.
